title: A privacy-preserving image classification method based on federated learning

pse.problem: The invention aims to efficiently utilize unmarked data and discretely distributed marked data in image classification while protecting privacy.
pse.solution_function: The system performs a privacy-preserving image classification based on federal learning. It utilizes a network consisting of a server, a card shuffler, and N clients. The server obtains unmarked public data, normalizes it, and initializes a global neural network. Each client acquires local real data, normalizes it, trains a local neural network, calculates the local global neural network, and sends it to the server.
pse.solution_structure: The system comprises a server, a card shuffler, and N clients. The server has components for obtaining, normalizing, and initializing global neural networks. Each client has components for acquiring, normalizing local data, training local neural networks, and calculating the local global neural network.
pse.solution_implementation: The server first obtains unmarked public data, normalizes it, and initializes a global neural network M G. It then sends the public key pk, the global neural network M G, and a common data set D P to the card shuffler. pse.effect: The system effectively utilizes unmarked data by marking data, protects privacy using differential privacy technology, improves image classification precision while maintaining data privacy of clients.
